evidence: Carries the Wallet label and removes transaction deletion code from src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp.
rationale: Removes the deprecated `removeprunedfunds` RPC and eliminates underlying wallet transaction deletion routines that added complexity and footguns. The PR description notes that 'having irrelevant transactions inside of wallet is harmless' and commit df1f84d459 states 'there is never a good reason to delete tx data from a wallet, so delete these functions', making this a solid cleanup of unneeded database logic.
